name: Family gathering
description: Holidays, reunions and big dinners. Pick one person as the host (Grandma is a classic) and see who knows them best.

questions.text: Who in the family calls the host the most?
What's the host's favourite family memory?
What does the host always say at dinner?
Which decade was the host's favourite?
What's really in the secret family recipe
The title of the family reality show
How many people are at this gathering today?
